scientific_question: Does Hindsight's accepted official uv.lock deterministically yield a complete third-party dependency list for hindsight-all without network resolution, dependency installation, or local workspace references?
decision_informed: Whether a hash-complete wheelhouse acquisition stage can be frozen from one immutable dependency list.
scientific_evidence_role: dependency-lock export evidence only; no wheel acquisition, package installation, import, model, service, lifecycle, numerical, superiority, or SOTA claim is permitted

interpreter_identity.access: read-only interpreter selection; no package is installed into its prefix

execution_contract.wave1_non_interference: The stage parses an existing lock and writes two text exports only; it cannot access models, datasets, package indexes, pg0, APIs, shared environments, or GPUs.

acceptance: Source revision, cleanliness, uv.lock bytes/hash, uv bytes/hash/version, and Python executable hash/version match the frozen identities.
Both export passes succeed with --frozen and --offline and cannot update uv.lock.
uv.lock has identical SHA-256 before and after export and the source remains clean.
The two requirements exports are byte-identical and non-empty.
The export contains the required embedded database, local embedding/reranker, CPU Torch, and Transformers dependencies.
The export contains no editable, file URL, source checkout, or Hindsight workspace-package reference.
The evidence root is TERMINAL_ACCEPTED without TERMINAL_REJECTED and all files have a retained SHA-256 inventory.
failure: Any collision, identity mismatch, source mutation, network requirement, export disagreement, missing required package, local path leakage, command failure, or timeout seals the evidence root as TERMINAL_REJECTED and preserves all outputs.
next_gate_after_acceptance: Independently audit and retain the canonical requirements export, then freeze download/build of a project-owned wheelhouse. No package installation or model acquisition is authorized by export acceptance.
prohibited_actions: using a different Python or uv executable
installing any requirement or writing into the shared Python prefix
downloading models or starting pg0/service/lifecycle/numerical work
populating any comparison-table numeric cell from this stage
